approach: Static recompilation of x86 game code to C with the XboxRecomp runtime and Direct3D 11 rendering
notes: Menu rendering and controller navigation are verified. Videos and gameplay run, but renderer failures still cause exits; texture and shader support and audio DSP effects remain incomplete. Sustained optimized performance is unverified. Requires the XboxRecomp impl-scghost branch and legally obtained game files, which are not supplied.
